title: ID0467840-DC/Si-D/IE-[MULTIPLE] Modbus and SECC communication Failure
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Modbus and SECC communication Failure
Solution: No failure during sessions, when sessions end successfully we send a message error since SECC resets the PLC communication.

additional_info.subject: Escalation: Siemens SiCharge D internal comms failures (modbus0 not connected, SECC offline) across multiple charge points
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
We are escalating a recurring systemic fault pattern across multiple Siemens SiCharge D charge points in our network. OCPP connectivity remains stable and online, however EVSEs repeatedly enter Faulted state with Siemens vendor errors that point to internal cabinet communications and SECC availability issues.
The repeated pattern is that ChargePointStatus remains Available and ConnectivityStatus remains Online, while EVSEs and connectors report Faulted with InternalError and Siemens vendor messages indicating readiness and internal comms failures.
ChargePointId 170003302
11 Dec 2025: EVSEs 1, 2, 3, 4 report Faulted with InternalError.
12 Dec 2025 and 13 Dec 2025: EVSE 3 reports Faulted with VendorErrorCode “modbus0 is not connected” (repeated).
ChargePointId 170003303
11 Dec 2025: EVSE 2 reports Faulted with InternalError.
12 Dec 2025: EVSE 1 and EVSE 2 report Faulted with VendorErrorCode “evse is not ready” (repeated on EVSE 1).
ChargePointId 170003304
09 Dec 2025: EVSE 1 reports Faulted with VendorErrorCode “SECC Status not updated”. EVSE 2 reports Faulted with VendorErrorCode “secc is offline”.
11 Dec 2025: EVSE 4 reports Faulted with VendorErrorCode “modbus0 is not connected”. EVSE 3 reports Faulted with VendorErrorCode “secc pilot is E”.
12–13 Dec 2025: multiple EVSEs report Faulted with VendorErrorCode “evse is not ready”, alongside InternalError events.
These errors indicate internal fieldbus communication loss (“modbus0 is not connected”) and SECC unavailability (“secc is offline”, “SECC Status not updated”), resulting in EVSE readiness failure (“evse is not ready”). This is not consistent with user misuse or vehicle-specific incidents and appears to be cabinet level or shared subsystem instability.
We request cabinet level diagnostics and engineering review for these charge points, with specific attention to:
Identification of what subsystem is mapped to “modbus0” on this hardware build and the likely causes of Modbus disconnection.
SECC health and communication monitoring, including reasons for “SECC Status not updated” and “secc is offline”.
Internal logs around the timestamps above, including watchdog resets, PSU stability events, brownout indicators, bus timeout counters, and safety controller triggers.
Firmware versions for cabinet controller and SECC, and confirmation of any known issues relating to Modbus dropouts, SECC offline events, or repeated EVSE readiness failures on this firmware branch.
Recommended corrective action beyond resets, including whether Siemens recommends proactive replacement of SECC modules, comms interface boards, cabinet harness components, or other internal modules when this pattern is present.
Given the recurrence across several charge points in the same period, we suspect either a common firmware issue or a common hardware subsystem weakness. We need root cause identification and a permanent fix.
Please confirm next steps and ownership for engineering escalation, and advise what immediate site actions Siemens recommends (full power-down sequence, module reseat checks, comms termination checks, or targeted module replacement).
Regards,
Colin

additional_info.body:
Hello Colin,
I believe Jason already explained to you this subject because I was out of office and he left me a message.
Since there is no issue with the charging sessions, it's the same as the previous ticket. For now, this is how the system is designed, the SECC sends this false positive in a way of internally addressing it as a session end.
For now, if there is any real complaint from the customer please let us know, otherwise, Jason will keep you updated on any news we might have. I will close the ticket.
Thank you and have a nice holidays.
Best regards,
Francisco
